children: Nasdaq, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.39 billion, up 20.9% from a year earlier. Net income attributable to Nasdaq increased 27.8% to $540 million, while diluted EPS rose 31.3% to $0.96.
Revenue was $2.39B, compared with $1.98B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 20.9%.
Net income attributable to Nasdaq was $540M, compared with $423M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 27.8%.
Diluted EPS was $0.96, compared with $0.73 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 31.3%.
Revenue less transaction-based expenses increased 12.6%. Capital Access Platforms grew 20.2%, and Financial Technology grew 15.8%.
Nasdaq index-tracking ETP assets reached a record $1.16 trillion, supported by record trailing-12-month net inflows of $141 billion.
Financial Technology revenue grew 16% and annual recurring revenue rose 18%. The business signed 54 new clients, five cross-sells and 135 upsells during the quarter.
Nasdaq welcomed 15 U.S. operating-company listings that raised $32 billion, captured eight of the 10 largest IPOs and recorded a 79% win rate.
Market Services set a third-quarter net-revenue record, supported by higher U.S. options and European equity volumes and a stronger U.S. cash-equity share.
